ethernet_category_recommendation.description: Guide for selecting Ethernet cable category in D38999-style connectors

categories.use_when: 1000BASE-T over short runs (<30m) where cost matters

selection_rules: For 1 Gbps: Cat5e minimum, Cat6 recommended for margin
For 2.5G/5G BASE-T: Cat6 minimum, Cat6A recommended
Always verify the exact PN supports the claimed category
Cable assembly (not just connector) determines actual performance
Shorter cable runs are more forgiving of category limitations
